articles.title: Alduin's Bane Walkthrough - The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Guide - IGN
articles.summary: With an Elder Scroll in hand, you're ready to find out how the ancient heroes defeated the World Eater in the past in the Alduin's Bane quest. This
articles.body:
With an Elder Scroll in hand, you're ready to find out how the ancient heroes defeated the World Eater in the past in the Alduin's Bane quest. This is the thirteenth main quest of Skyrim , and begins immediately upon retrieving the Elder Scroll at the end of Elder Knowledge .

Learn the “Dragonrend” Shout from the Nord heroes

Return to the Throat of the World atop High Hrothgar. If you're still in the Tower of Mzark, you can leave via the lift to the east, which also activates another shortcut down to Blackreach should you wish to return.

Once you return to Paarthurnax, read the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound. You will find the Elder Scroll in the Books section of your inventory menu.

For a while, you'll watch a flashback depicting how the Nord Heroes had banished Alduin from Skyrim. Sit back and watch it unfold. By the end of this flashback, you learn the Dragonrend shout.

At this point, you'll have to fight Alduin. Paarthurnax will help you, but he won't do much in terms of damage. The key is to use Dragonrend whenever it recharges to cause Alduin to crash down to the ground. When he's on the ground, he's much easier to attack.

Be careful not to accidentally use Dragonrend on Paarthurnax , however. They can sometimes be easily confused, though the quest marker will always point towards Alduin.

Alduin fights like any other dragon you have encountered: flies around, spews fiery or icy breaths (in this case both), and snaps with his mighty jaws. Plus, avoid falling debris when Alduin uses his shout, calling meteors down on you. In fact, you can actually use Clear Skies to negate this meteor storm.

You will have to use Dragonrend against him and follow-up with plenty of damage multiple times, since Alduin has a ton of health. Eventually you'll wear him down and then fly away.

This leads directly into The Fallen main quest, where you must question one of his allies to find where Alduin's hiding.

The first physical edition of the Dungeon Crawler Carl books was a paperback version that Matt Dinniman self-published alongside the eBook. The series didn't get an actual hardcover edition until more recently, following the publishing rights being acquired by Penguin Random House in 2024. The first official hardcover was released in August 2024. The latest book, A Parade of Horribles , was the first in the series to get all formats released at once.

In addition to the standard hardcovers, there's also a Deluxe Edition of the first book up for preorder. It officially releases on November 17, 2026 and will likely be followed by other Deluxe Editions later on. Here are the official details from the product page:

A stunning cover and artwork by acclaimed artist Victo Ngai

A fully illustrated hardcover case featuring a solvable maze

Illustrations on the inside of the jacket

A 4-color printed ribbon marker featuring Carl and Donut on the run

A Q&A with author Matt Dinniman, conducted by GC, BWR, NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk herself

If you're looking to buy the Dungeon Crawler Carl hardcover editions, you should be able to find them available at pretty much any online bookstore . The popularity of the series means you should be able to find copies at your local bookstore or Barnes & Noble as well. If you're looking for the overall best place to get a discount, Amazon is the way to go.

The best time to buy books in general is when Amazon has some sort of special promotion. The most recent example of this is the '3 for 2' sale on books the retailer offered for Prime Day 2026 , which included almost all of the DCC hardcovers.

articles.title: Anton Godwin's Jester Hat - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Anton Godwin is an NPC in Enshrouded and he lost his prized Jester Hat somewhere along the line. In this quest, you'll be tasked with finding and
articles.body:
Anton Godwin is an NPC in Enshrouded and he lost his prized Jester Hat somewhere along the line. In this quest , you'll be tasked with finding and recovering the fun hat. If you want to know how to trigger Anton Godwin's Jester Hat or where to find the hat itself, we've got everything you need to know in this Enshrouded guide.

Anton Godwin's Jester Hat is sitting in a chest inside a small settlement called New Cromville in the Albaneve Summits. This region is northwest of the Albaneve Ancient Spire, and has been completely swallowed up by the Shroud.

Most of the enshrouded areas in the Albaneve Summits are in deep valleys surrounded by mountains, and New Cromville is no different. To get there, fast travel to the Albaneve Ancient Summit and head northwest until you pass by the Event Honor Hall .

That's about the halfway point, so continue northwest from there, and eventually, you will find yourself on a massive cliff overlooking an enshrouded valley below. You will be able to spot some tower tops poking out from the Shroud. That's New Cromville.

Soar down there and reach the settlement entrance. Stand in front of the door and look up and to your right to spot a grapple point. Haul yourself up there and turn left immediately to find a long passage way. Go all the way to the end and turn around to spot another grapple point.

Walk forward to find a silver chest containing Anton Godwin's Jester Hat and complete your quest. There is also a lore page on the right called All Preparations are Done , which gives you some more background information on the hat.

articles.title: Oscar Godwin's Cousin - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Oscar Godwin's Cousin is an Enshrouded side quest that sends you on a mission to rescue Oscar Godwin's cousin, Anton Godwin. Anton Godwin has his own
articles.body:
Oscar Godwin's Cousin is an Enshrouded side quest that sends you on a mission to rescue Oscar Godwin's cousin, Anton Godwin. Anton Godwin has his own quests for you to embark on, like Anton Godwin's Jester Hat , for example, so saving him should definitely be on your to-do list. If you'res struggling to find Anton Godwin, we've got everything you need in this Enshrouded guide.

Oscar Godwin's cousin, A.K.A. Anton Godwin, is trapped in a prison cell in the Gateway Outpost "Drifa" . This is a large outpost that's been completely overrun by Vukah and Scavengers. You can find it on the path leading from the Kindlewastes to the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire, so either make your way there to reach the outpost, or glide southeast from the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire.

Once you reach the Gateway Outpost "Drifa", head inside to the main hall and defeat all the enemies there. There are lots of them, so prepare with lots of potions and weapons. The most ferocious enemy you will face there is a Scavenger Tyrant, so keep your wits about you and watch your back as you clear the area.

Once the coast is clear, head upstairs to pick up the What To Do With the Prisoners? lore page before making your way back downstairs and exiting through the doors on the western side of the building.

The Albaneve Summits Prison: What To Do With the Prisoners?

Turn left, and climb the metal grate on the outside of the building to reach the tower. Move inside and climb the staircases, keeping an eye on the cells on each floor. There is a skeleton in a cell on the second floor. Interact with it to retrieve Anton Godwin's soul and bring him back to your base. Use your summoning staff to introduce him to his new home and complete the quest.

articles.summary: Lou is a unique character that you can encounter while playing Probably Stolen. She shows up as a Wanted Criminal, but you have the opportunity to learn more
articles.body:
Lou is a unique character that you can encounter while playing Probably Stolen . She shows up as a Wanted Criminal , but you have the opportunity to learn more about her, depending on the decisions you make. In this guide, we're going to cover everything you need to know about how to complete and interact with Lou's Questline in Probably Stolen.

How to Complete Lou's Questline in Probably Stolen

As a Wanted Criminal, there's a chance Lou will appear at your storefront while you're playing.

When you first meet Lou, she's going to be upfront about her activities. She's looking for a type of melee weapon to use on a 'guest' of hers. The way she describes it, it's clear she's going to be torturing someone with the weapon you sell her.

You'll earn 1,500 Credits from Security for calling her in, but she does tell you that the brig won't hold her for long. She'll be back.

You'll have to wait a few days after this event for Lou to show up again.

Before that, a Republic Officer appears in front of your vendor. They explain that Lou will appear again and that she wants to play with you. They encourage you to play along with her. If you agree, you'll need to place a Transmitter inside a device that you'll give back to her. The Transmitter will give them the location of her hideout, and then they can deal with her. There are 750 Credits in it for you if you do it.

Following this brief meeting, Lou will reappear. But not before she places a bomb inside your workstation. If you interact with it to disarm the bomb, it turns out to be a fake.

She later returns to reveal that yes, the first bomb she left was fake.

Now, though, she has some errands to run, and she wants you to look after her box of toys. You'll need to look after it, not touch it or peek inside. Taking anything can result in her leaving another real bomb at your location.

She does find out if you do anything with it. It's better to leave it alone and return it to her when she gets back. For me, it only took a day before she returned.

When she does return, if you didn't peek, she offers you a choice of four different items: an Advanced Turbo Booster, Smuggler's Bay, Backpack (small), or two Module Bay Expansion Kits. You can pick your preferred choice.

If you didn't put the transmitter into the box, you'll next see Lou in a Security disguise. You won't have any choice but to give in to her inspection. However, before it happens, she reveals that it's actually her, and not a standard Security officer. She's beyond excited because her guest finally told her what she needed to learn, and she was about to go out and complete her mission. However, she also wants you to pay for the amount that you got for her bounty. She'll demand that you give her 750 Credits worth of supplies, and you have until next week to pay her.

When she returns after that week, she'll ask you to offer the 750 Credits worth of supplies. You can give her Weapons, Ammunition, Medical Supplies, Melee Weapons, or any other type of firearm. You have to place them on your counter and donate them to her. Once they've been donated and you give her the total amount, Lou departs with a brief goodbye, saying you might see her again in the future.

She does return later to provide you with a thank-you note, and then a random reward. For our run, we received a Storage Bay Expansion Kit, but others have received Storage Bays themselves, or other items. Regardless of what item you receive, after Lou's thank-you note, she disappears.

articles.title: Doctor Doom Is Not a Tony Stark Variant in Avengers: Doomsday, Confirms Kevin Feige
articles.summary: Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday.
articles.body:
Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday .

When speaking with Empire Magazine, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige debunked the popular fan theory that Doctor Doom and Tony Stark have a shared connection in the multiverse. Fans have speculated that Doom is a "variant" of Stark, since Robert Downey Jr. plays both characters . Variants are other versions of a character across the multiverse. We've seen this with the three Spider-Men, Wolverine, and Loki, so naturally, some fans thought this may all be an elaborate way to explain how Robert Downey Jr. is also playing Doom... turns out, it's not.

“Is Steve Rogers a Johnny Storm variant?" asked Feige. "People wondered, ‘Is Doom just a variant of another character? Is this just a shortcut to bringing back another character?’ The answer is no. He’s Victor Von Doom.”

Avengers: Doomsday Trailer: First Look at Doctor Doom

As for what Doom's whole deal is, the creative team behind the film teased what kind of energy he brings and why he is the way he is. The Russo Brothers, who are directing the film, teased that Doom has lost a child, is a "victim of trauma" and has a greater ego than Thanos. They also noted that he's a pretty terrifying presence.

"Doom is a Gothic character,” said director Joe Russo. “He says, ‘Hell answers to me,’ and he’s not kidding. He’s a very powerful character with some very dark magic, and he’s not above selling his soul to get what he wants. He’s worth being scared of.”

Robert Downey Jr. also noted that he was excited to lean into being a villain this time around, and suggested that Doom's plans have a tremendous scope to them.

"I like a bit of scorched earth,” teases Downey Jr. “Whatever you think he may be entertaining, I would ten times it, and you’ll probably be closer to the ballpark."

There's still a lot that we don't know about the film, which is just a little over a month away from being released. A recent listing on the WGA's website credited Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds for contributing to the film's script, which seems to suggest Wolverine and Deadpool may be in the film . Additionally, Marvel confirmed earlier this week that Scarlet Witch will also return in Avengers: Doomsday , though seemingly under the control of Doom himself.

Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18.

articles.title: The Game Awards 2026 are Coming to Disney+
articles.summary: This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.
articles.body:
This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.

This partnership with Disney comes as the media monolith seeks to promote its roster of video games and game-related media projects, which Kingdom Hearts fans will note comes right on the heels of its big KH4 reveal at D23 earlier this year.

Reports from Variety state that this packed slate includes Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation, as well as Death Stranding Isolations , the forthcoming anime series based on Hideo Kojima’s Death Stranding franchise. The show got its first proper trailer in late October, alongside a first look at a full-length anime film set in the Death Stranding universe, Mosquito , which is set for a theatrical release on an as-yet unannounced date.

There are already a slew of strong contenders for this year’s Game Awards, the bulk of which you can read on IGN’s Biggest Games of 2026 Playlist . Resident Evil 9, 007: First Light, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake are just a few of the heavy hitters in an already packed slate — not to mention GTA 6, which will qualify for the Awards by the skin of its teeth after its arrival on November 19.

This marks the first time The Game Awards has been offered on Disney+, which continues to expand its reach after snagging Amazon’s Prime Video last year. The program will also stream on its official profiles on Twitch, YouTube, Instagram Live, TikTok, Steam, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Kick.

Somewhat ironically, the TGAs will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The show will air on Thursday, December 10 at 7:30pm ET / 4:30pm PT and will be hosted by Geoff Keighley.

Kingdom Hearts 4 Extended Gameplay Trailer | D23 2026

The Game Awards is always rife with exciting news, reveals, performances, and sometimes, even drama, as seen last year when comedian Andrew Schulz ruffled some feathers after calling out the cast of the Mortal Kombat movie . With some big games having already been announced, like Resident Evil: Veronica and The Witcher 4 , fans are more hopeful than ever that they'll get to see more of these titles at the year's most prestigious game awards event.

Nominees for The Game Awards are determined by a jury of more than 100 media outlets, journalists, and creators, including IGN. Winners are selected by vote, comprised of 90% voting jury and 10% fan votes .

articles.title: How to Become a Cop - Rob Run Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Police Officer is one of the roles you can choose to play in Rob Run. As a Police Officer, you'll be fighting against the criminals running around the
articles.body:
Police Officer is one of the roles you can choose to play in Rob Run . As a Police Officer, you'll be fighting against the criminals running around the city, attempting to stop them and confiscate their belongings. You can only do this if you're a Cop. In this guide, we'll be covering everything you need to know about how to become a Cop in Rob Run.

You can become a Police Officer when you reach Looty Bay, the open-world area of Rob Run. When you arrive, you start off as a civilian.

If you haven't chosen to become a Criminal, you can choose to be a cop instead. To do this, you need to find a Police Station.

The Police Station is at the center of the map on the south side, to the west of the Hospital.

When you arrive, head inside and speak with the Police Officer on duty. You'll have a list of options to choose from when speaking with them, and the first option is to Start Duty.

When you choose to Start Duty, you receive an equipment kit. As you perform well as a Police Officer and receive badges, you get better gear.

However, when you start, you'll only receive the Patrol Officer items. Any other equipment you were carrying is left at the Police Station while you're on duty, and you can retrieve it when you return.

articles.title: How to Launder Money - Rob Run Guide - IGN
articles.summary: You won't be able to launder money right away in Rob Run. First, you have to buy yourself a safe place to do it, which means you'll have to earn a
articles.body:
You won't be able to launder money right away in Rob Run . First, you have to buy yourself a safe place to do it, which means you'll have to earn a sizeable amount of income. Below, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about getting yourself set up!

The way you launder money in Rob Run is by owning a plot of land .

When you buy the Land Plot Title, make your way to any of the level 1 Districts outside of Looty Bay, and settle down there.

Inside, there's a cash laundering station. Any money you receive from a Fence or a Smuggler can go here.

However, before you can begin to launder your money, you've got to have a bank account. You can open one up at Looty Bay.

You can open a bank account at the Looty Bay Bank, on the northeast side of the map. There, you'll need to deposit $5,000 to create an account. Then, head back to your base and interact with the Laundering Desk. Place all of the cash you want to begin laundering, and the process will start.

Your money is still not safe, though. It takes time to be laundered... just like real laundry. When it's done, you can then transfer it to your account to protect it.

articles.body:
Forever Waiting is a quick Enshrouded quest that sends you to Everfore Keep, a well-guarded fortress in the Albaneve Summits. If you're looking for a way to get into Everfore Keep or you want to know where to find the treasure on the tower, you'll find everything you need in this Enshrouded guide.

To get to Evermore Keep, fast travel to the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire and soar off the northeastern side.

Drop down on the path, and start following it. You'll pass through an enshrouded area, the Gateway Outpost "Alba", the eventually find yourself in the Forge of Obsidia.

The Forge of Obsidia is actually the location of another quest, A Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith . Defeat enemies inside the main forge room until one of them drops the Bellows item. Tuck that away in your pack and use it to craft a Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith once you get back to your base!

For now, continue through the Forge by taking the doorway to the right and following that up a set of stairs. Turn left at the top of the stairs to get back outside again. Turn left as soon as you exit the building and continue following the path until you reach a dead-end.

Take a closer look at the cliff on your right to discover a cave entrance and a new path. Follow it until it branches and you can see some steel arches on the right. Take the path leading left, and continue following it to reach Evermore Keep.

Evermore Keep is locked up tight, so sneak around the traps to the locked door on the left and use a Lockpick to open it. Once you're in, head forward and go up the stairs to find yourself in a courtyard. Climb the stairs opposite and run up to a pile of rubble.

Turn left when you reach the rubble and follow the path around the side of the building to reach a grate. Climb the grate and run up the stairs on the left. Work your way around the grounds until you reach the highest tower. Once you do, head inside and go up the stairs.

Use the Grapple Point and look to your right to spot a lore page sitting on top of a desk called There's Too Much Paperwork!

From there, drop down the hole in the center of the room and read the next lore page at the bottom called We're on Break .

There's also another one on the shelf near the door leading outside called Follow-Up On the Request for Recruit Names .

Follow-Up On the Request for Recruit Names

Turn to face the west, and follow the halls until you pop back outside again. Follow the steps on the right around the building until you reach a pile of rubble.

Dig through that with your pickaxe to uncover the treasure and complete the Forever Waiting quest.

The mission to retrieve the Lesser Twinflame Sword sends you to the depths of a Shroud-covered lake in the Albaneve Summits. Finding things in the Shroud can be particularly hard, so if you're struggling to find the Lonely Grave, you'll find everything you need to get there in this Enshrouded guide .

The Lonely Grave is an isolated burial site at the top of a massive rock overhanging Lake Luma in the Albaneve Summits. Lake Luma is in the northwestern portion of the Albaneve Summits, just northwest of the Event Honor Hall.

After passing the Event Honor Hall, keep following the path until you eventually spot an abandoned building with large, green, circular doors. Just opposite that building is a huge cliff overlooking Lake Luma.

If you investigate the Shroud, you will spot the tips of some towers just poking through the Shroud. That's the New Cromville settlement, where you can find Anton Godwin's Jester Hat . To the right of that is the Lonely Grave.

Leap off the cliff and aim for the Shroud's edge on the right. If you drop down in the right spot, you will find yourself on a large cliff overlooking the lake. If you just miss, you might find yourself on the lake itself. If so, run to the northern back, where you will find solid land.

Follow the hill up the edge of the wall to reach the top, where you'll encounter a few enemies. Take them out and approach the tip of the ledge. There, you will find the Lonely Grave. Equip a pickaxe and dig into the grave to retrieve the Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword .

Beds and Shelter is an Enshrouded quest that tasks you with providing shelter for the farming assistant, Fenrig, so he can operate to his full potential. If you're wondering what exactly constitutes 'shelter' and how to create it, we've got everything you need to know in this Enshrouded guide.

So you've successfully completed the Bring Back the Pure Souls quest and got yourself a farming assistant to spice up your base. But Fenrig can't operate properly without some shelter! The first thing you need to get started is some sort of room. You will probably already have a decent base going by the time you rescue Fenrig.

But if not, the lands are full of ruins in Enshrouded, and if you don't have enough materials to craft a base from scratch, those places offer excellent base opportunities. Many of them will only require a little patching up, and they are good to go! Rookmore and Long Keep are great first base options!

If you're making a base or house for Fenrig from scratch, your first stop should be the workbench. There, you can craft building materials that you can use to create walls, floors, windows, and doors for your structure. Then, equip your Construction Hammer and select a floor tile. Lay out a base in whatever shape feels good for you, then craft some walls to border it.

Place a roof on top to complete your building. It doesn't even need a door to count as shelter, although adding one is a good idea. Once your structure is complete, craft a bed to place in there. The most basic bed option is the Crude Mattress, which you can craft using the following materials:

4x Torn Cloth: Found by defeating enemies.

4x Plant Fiber: Gathered from bushes and shrubbery.

Place your bed inside the structure, then use your Summoning Staff to summon Fenrig to the area. Click on the bed to assign it to him and complete your quest!

articles.title: Microsoft Struggling to Fix Global System Outage Impacting Email Systems and More, Admits Initial Repairs 'Not Taking as Expected'
articles.summary: Microsoft is struggling to fix a prolonged systems outage that has hindered access to online services including Outlook and Teams.
articles.body:
Microsoft is struggling to fix a prolonged systems outage that has hindered access to online services including Outlook and Teams.

On the upside, AI tool Copilot has also been impacted.

For more than 12 hours, users around the world have been reporting an inability to access email accounts, instant messaging systems, and documents via OneDrive and Office365. No Xbox services are believed to be offline, however.

Microsoft was quick to acknowledge the problem and admit that it was suffering from issues with its server capabilities, with "elevated load across multiple regions." Attempts to solve this were initially unsuccessful, however, as the company reported its fixes were "not taking as expected."

"We've monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected," Microsoft said in a lengthy thread on X/Twitter. "We're identifying alternate workstreams that can be applied to increase capacity in the face of sustained traffic management imbalances."

Hours later, Microsoft seemed to have changed tack and was now trying to carve out the impacted servers completely as it struggled to make progress.

"We're aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact," the company then stated. "We've paused all deployments, we're moving additional traffic off the affected infrastructure, and we're restarting affected servers to return them to service."

Why is this happening? Microsoft has blamed a number of servers becoming "unexpectedly unavailable", adding strain to its remaining capacity, rather than any sudden increase in traffic. That would suggest this is not a targeted DDOS attack, and indeed, Microsoft exec Charles LaManna has confirmed "there is no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity."

We'll update again when there's been further developments. In the meantime, hopefully you're having a quiet day at work or school.

articles.title: After Giving Away Thousands of Dollars in Cosmetics, Fortnite is Teasing a Big Reveal For Captain X, Its Mysterious Masked Treasure Man — With Fan Guesses Ranging From Mr Beast to Obama
articles.summary: Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X.
articles.body:
Fortnite is teasing a big reveal for its upcoming December 5 live event, which will reveal the identity of mysterious new character Captain X.

The game has previously employed big-name stars such as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and Brie Larson to portray notable in-game characters, and appears to be on the cusp of unveiling yet another casting of some significance.

Captain X made their debut at the beginning of Fortnite's current treasure-hunting mini-season, though their motives are currently unclear. As Fortnite's heroes hunt a fresh macguffin, Captain X has seemingly allowed them to make steady progress, while the game's story has suggested the character could also simply be letting players do their legwork instead, before swooping in to steal the prize.

At the same time, Fortnite itself has introduced a treasure hunting mechanic where players can win a fortnight of free access to the game's lucrative Item Shop — something that has sent concurrent player numbers soaring into the millions (all timed to cushion the blow of GTA 6's launch.)

Whether Captain X turns out to be friend or foe remains unclear, as does their relation to the game's wider storyline. This currently features a roster of surviving heroes from much of the game's past decade returning to face down Geno, Fortnite's uber Big Bad from the days when Epic Games' former creative boss Donald Mustard was still in charge of the storyline.

Should Geno actually be defeated, finally, will Captain X be revealed as the next major threat? Or perhaps they will be a new hero for players to follow, should Jonesy finally fall in battle?

Whatever is the case, Epic Games is clearly now teasing that there's more to Captain X than meets the eye. Last night at the Streamer Awards 2026, Captain X turned up in person wearing a mask to deliver a hand-written note confirming that they would be fully unveiled on December 5 — the date of Fortnite's next Chapter-ending live event.

Genuine question. Who could this possibly be that would be both exciting to see and fitting for Captain X's character. Like, the Foundation being The Rock only worked because there was a year of buildup and a lack of notable names in Fortnite. We have like everyone in the game now. Not even trying to be miserable or anything here, I'm just absolutely lost as to who he(?) could possibly be. — kat (@kattylotl) November 13, 2026

Genuine question. Who could this possibly be that would be both exciting to see and fitting for Captain X's character. Like, the Foundation being The Rock only worked because there was a year of buildup and a lack of notable names in Fortnite. We have like everyone in the game now. Not even trying to be miserable or anything here, I'm just absolutely lost as to who he(?) could possibly be.

Currently, Captain X has only appeared in-game with their face covered, while their dialogue has been disguised with a heavy voice filter. (Players previously worked out that The Rock was playing a key character pretty quickly from his voice lines, even though he remained masked for almost a year — something that has not yet happened this time around.)

But who is it under the mask? Fans are speculating that the character will be played by a well-known actor or celebrity, with many suspecting that MrBeast has been brought on board. The YouTube star is already available in Fortnite as a character skin, and Captain X's ability to dole out hugely valuable prizes certainly lines up with MrBeast's usual shtick. Other fans have suggested the X is actually a clue this will be a new character played by Elon Musk, which seems extremely unlikely. And even less possibly, others have rounded on the idea that this seemingly generous person is actually President Barack Obama — which would certainly be a booking.

If you can tear yourself away from GTA 6 in time for December's Fortnite live event, we'll find out for sure what's going on, in just under a month's time.

articles.title: Xbox 25th Anniversary Console Stock Sells Out in Seconds, Sparking Fan Fury Over Scalping and Limited Supply
articles.summary: Fans have been left furious by Microsoft's launch of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X console, which sold out within seconds online. Now, scalpers are cashing in.
articles.body:
Fans have been left furious by Microsoft's handling of its 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X console launch, after stock sold out within seconds online.

Social media is awash with reports from players who attempted to purchase one of the company's snazzy translucent green 25th Anniversary consoles from the Microsoft Store, only for stock to sell out before they could finish making their order.

To be fair, Microsoft had previously stated it would only have a "limited number" of consoles to sell at launch. In a social media post earlier this week, the company noted that availability would begin at midnight Eastern time and that quantities and availability would "vary by market and retailer."

Still, numerous fans were left empty-handed, or angered by retailers such as GameStop taking advantage of the low stock situation by selling the $999 console at a huge markup. For a time, GameStop was shifting its stock allocation at the eye-watering price of $4,950 , although even this now appears to have sold out.

XBOX Series X25 Limited Edition Console Images

Much of the criticism has been levied against Microsoft itself, however, for only making a small number of consoles available and for not having a better online queueing system available. Some fans have suggested that purchases could have been limited to customers with Xbox accounts to prove their legitimacy and limit bulk buying. This option could have even been tightened further to offer the console first to Xbox's most dedicated fans — perhaps those with older account status, or those who have collected a certain amount of Gamerscore.

Whatever the potential solution, however, Microsoft appears to have just let its stock go on sale via a first-come, first-serve basis. Inevitably, this has lead to numerous consoles being placed upon eBay at a notable markup. Looking online this morning, IGN has seen dozens of Xbox 25th Anniversary consoles that have already been sold through eBay for $1,500, and up to $2,500.

"At this point I don't even care anymore," one Xbox fan wrote in a post on X/Twitter. "I tried back in August, I tried last night and I tried tonight. Yea im upset I cant get one of these due to scalpers but, I just cant find it in myself to care anymore. I love Xbox, but what a mess."

"It's all a joke," another fan added , comparing the launch to Sony's similar PS5 anniversary consoles. "They’re made specifically for bots, scalpers and to be backdoored. No genuine fans actually get these."

"I have been a Xbox loyal fan for 20+ years and I can't even get my hands on this," added another fan. "I stayed up and have been trying to get one since 12pm YESTERDAY. You do nothing for the loyals and let these scalpers and bots take them all. Nothing restocked. When I ended up getting one in my cart the f***ing website just loaded and loaded until it disappeared. Just a f***ing shame. Beyond pissed off rn."

Last month, Xbox boss Asha Sharma insisted that falling sales of Xbox consoles had been hampered by supply constraints , and that there was "more demand than consoles available."

Deadpool Star Ryan Reynolds has acknowledged yesterday's report that he will get a writing credit on the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday .

Reynolds is listed alongside a variety of other contributors to Doomsday's script via the Writers Guild of America's website , though the extent to which Reynolds (and his Deadpool & Wolverine co-star Hugh Jackman, too) have actually added to Doomsday's dialogue remains to be seen.

Doomsday is primarily written by Marvel veterans Christopher Markus and Stephen McFeely, who previously wrote both Avengers: Infinity War and Endgame. Today, however, Reynolds appears to have verified his additional involvement by issuing a brief but humorous response to the matter.

The Most Surprising Avengers and Marvel Characters Not Announced for Doomsday

In a post on X/Twitter, Reynolds quoted a post revealing that he and Jackman had written parts of Doomsday and added a short clip from Deadpool & Wolverine. The scene sees Reynolds chatting with Matthew Macfadyen's Mr. Paradox, and declaring that he does not read.

The moment is likely just meant as a jokey nod to the fact that yes, in real life, Reynolds can indeed read and write and has done so on various projects. The Detective Pikachu star holds writing credits on Deadpool 2 and Deadpool & Wolverine, and has previously discussed working on a future Deadpool movie also.

Ryan Reynolds (@VancityReynolds) November 12, 2026

It's an intriguing situation, as Deadpool and Wolverine have technically not been officially confirmed to appear in Avengers: Doomsday, even though both Reynolds and Jackman have been busy promoting the movie via tongue-in-cheek promos at San Diego Comic-Con and D23 over the summer. Still, fans strongly expect the pair to appear, and leaks point to them having a small but significant presence in the film as various multiverses collide.

articles.title: Friday the 13th Is Getting Its First New Movie in Nearly 20 Years
articles.summary: Jason Vorhees is set to return in a 13th(!) Friday the 13th movie, the first in the horror slasher franchise in nearly 20 years.
articles.body:
Jason Vorhees is set to return in a 13th(!) Friday the 13th movie, the first in the horror slasher franchise in nearly 20 years.

Word comes from Deadline , which reports Steve Miner is in place to direct the new movie due out in 2027. Miner directed 1981’s Friday the 13th Part 2, 1982’s Friday the 13th Part III, and 1998’s Halloween H20: 20 Years Later. David Fliegel is writing the script.

The last Friday the 13th movie was the 2009 reboot . New prequel series, Crystal Lake , came out on Peacock in October and finally introduced a key mission component of Jason Voorhees’ history . It became Peacock’s fourth-best scripted-original debut. IGN’s Crystal Lake review returned an 8/10. We said: “Crystal Lake works in large part thanks to Linda Cardellini’s turn as Pamela Voorhees, while showrunner Brad Caleb Kane brings a thorough knowledge of the original source material to the series.”

How to Watch the Friday the 13th Movies in Chronological Order

Deadline said the new film will be financed and produced by the Barsamian family, which controls the franchise through their company Horror, Inc. Horror, Inc. launched the ‘Jason Universe’ as part of a plan to revive the franchise in 2024.

Long-running horror franchises are on something of a tear, in movies, TV shows, and video games. For example, Illfonic's Halloween: The Game came out in September. Saber's Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival came out in October. Mike Flanagan adapted Stephen King's horror classic, Carrie, for a Prime Video series that's getting a Season 2. Apparently Paramount is interested in reviving A Nightmare on Elm Street, too.

articles.title: It Looks Like Wolfenstein 3 Is Putting Nazis Where They Belong: Jail
articles.summary: The recent announcement of Wolfenstein 3 gave us barely anything, but the reveal of "Nazitraz" tells us something interesting about the sequel's story.
articles.body:
Xbox’s recent 25th anniversary-celebrating Fanfest finally made the long-rumoured Wolfenstein 3 official . MachineGames is developing the third part of its planned FPS trilogy, and I couldn’t be more excited. I replayed 2017’s The New Colossus at the start of the year, and its gory, executing-Nazis-in-front-of-a-live-television-audience finale was a good reminder of why MachineGames is one of the best in the business, and why so many shooter fans have held out hope for a third game over the past near-decade.

The announcement stopped short of almost anything beyond confirmation of Wolfenstein 3’s existence. No subtitle, no logo, no plot outline, and certainly no trailer. But Xbox CEO Asha Sharma did post an image showing off just the upper left corner of the script’s first page – barely six lines of notes and dialogue. But it’s enough to suggest that Wolfenstein 3 is working with a very fun concept: a jail for Nazis.

Chapter one is titled “Nazitraz”, a spin on Alcatraz, the famous prison facility off the coast of San Francisco. At the end of The New Colossus, B.J. and his allies trigger a revolution in Nazi-occupied America, and by the end of the credits it’s clear the revolt succeeded. That would put Alcatraz under the control of the revolutionaries, and so it’s no surprise that it would be turned into a prison for Nazis, or “Nazitraz”. This whole story began with B.J. escaping from a Nazi prison fortress in The Old Blood, so it’s somewhat classic poetry for it to begin its final chapter in a prison fortress not run by Nazis, but containing them.

Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more. — ASHA (@asha_shar) November 12, 2026

Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames. One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more.

The script’s dialogue paints a picture of B.J. entering an interrogation cell, where the captive inside immediately breaks down in panic. As MachineGames posted , “His reputation precedes him.” The Nazi goes by the name of Otto, and so he’ll be a new character for the modern series, but could well be inspired by Otto Giftmacher, the chemical weapons scientist from the original Wolfenstein 3D. Whoever he is, he should, of course, be afraid of the famous Nazi hunter.

From here, where the story goes is anyone’s guess, but mine would be that B.J. is shipping off to Europe again. Last year, in an interview with Noclip , MachineGames studio head Jerk Gustafsson said the team had "always seen [BJ's story] as a trilogy," and so this third game will need to finish his fight against the Nazis. He’ll need to strike at their German headquarters to finally cut the head off this snake, securing world peace.

Well, at least until that peace ends and the Nazis gain control of Europe – the need for the 1980s-set spinoff Wolfenstein: Youngblood to have Nazis to kill really does mean the main trilogy can’t end on a definitive victory. Somehow, they always return.

There’s one final line of the script visible: “Fergus moves in to pick up the…”. The mention of Fergus is unsurprising, since the angry Scott is a key part of the modern Wolfenstein ensemble, but it also suggests that Wolfenstein’s dual timelines will likely be returning.

If you can remember back to 2014’s Wolfenstein: The New Order , you’re asked to make a choice in the prologue: will you save the life of the young Probst Wyatt III, or the older, more grizzled Fergus Reid? Your choice dictates some small gameplay systems – health or armour upgrades, the ability to open specific doors – but more significantly, it makes the survivor a key player in the story. Your choice carries into the sequel via a save game file, and dictates the special weapon you’re given in The New Colossus.

Fergus’ presence in the script suggests that this timeline system is back (he’d surely have just been written out of the story if MachineGames didn’t want to include the option for Wyatt). And if the dual timeline is back, it seems likely that your save will be imported, and that there will once again be gameplay differences depending on who you chose to save all the way back in The New Order. With games and save files now being spread across several generations and not necessarily still in the possession of players, it seems likely that Wolfenstein 3 – just like The New Colossus – will replay the choice between Fergus and Wyatt as a flashback sequence, allowing you to re-pick your original choice or opt for a different version of events.

Alongside B.J. and Fergus, a screenshot of lead actor Brian Bloom performing across from Debra Wilson confirms that the latter’s character, revolutionary Grace Walker, will also return. We know that by the time of the events of Wolfenstein Youngblood she’s become the leader of the FBI, and so this third mainline chapter may well see her take on that position by its end.

Look, it’s barely anything to go on, so that’s about all we can glean from this announcement. That doesn’t mean there isn’t plenty to theorise about, though. Where do you think Wolfenstein 3 will take us, and what do you hope to see happen? Let us know in the comments.

Matt Purslow is IGN's Executive Editor of Features.

articles.title: The Legend of Zelda Series Was in 'Dire Straits' Before Breath of the Wild, Former Nintendo Marketing Leads Say
articles.summary: The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.
articles.body:
The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.

Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, who both worked at Nintendo for over a decade, made the claims on the latest episode of their podcast (as spotted by GamesRadar+ ). They refuted the idea that Breath of the Wild ruined the Zelda series with its new formula, and instead argued that it actually saved the franchise from a loss of relevance.

It comes as part of a discussion about “new Zelda” versus “old Zelda” — or essentially, the dungeon format versus a complete open world. While there is clearly a demand for the older Zelda games, as evidenced by the hugely successful Ocarina of Time remake, the pair say there is a good reason why Nintendo took them away from us in the first place.

“There has been some revisionist history out there lately, about how the Zelda team ripped these away from us at the peak of their popularity,” Ellis says. Yang then expresses her disbelief that fans think this way. “That’s ridiculous. This series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing.” Ellis goes into more detail: “I remember, I was going to the focus groups, and it was a really dark moment when the feedback [was that] the fanbase is dwindling, this is not bringing in new players.” Yang agrees again, saying that it was “depressing,” and that the playerbase was shrinking “smaller and smaller” with each new Zelda release.

Before Breath of the Wild came out in 2017, the Zelda series had seen Wii entry Skyward Sword in 2011, A Link Between Worlds in 2013, and various HD and 3D re-releases. Certainly, Breath of the Wild was an enormous hit, selling an incredible 34.28 million copes on the Switch. Its sequel, Tears of the Kingdom, came out in 2023 and has sold 22.90 million so far.

The Ocarina of Time remake looks like it continues the positive sales trend , becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game so far. The question now is, what will Nintendo do with its inevitable next mainline Zelda game?

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is out now exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2. You can read our review of the game here , or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. Be sure to check out our expanding Ocarina of Time Remake Walkthrough for comprehensive guides on each main quest area and dungeon, plus where to get Early Heart Pieces, Early Gold Skulltulas , and Early Item Bag Expansions . If you’re looking for more, don’t miss our complete guides to All Pieces of Heart , All Gold Skulltulas , and All Empty Bottles !

articles.title: Thousands of UK Gamers Face Downloading GTA 6's Pre-load For Over a Week Due to Poor Internet Speeds
articles.summary: Experts have warned that over 870,000 UK gamers could wait up to a week or more to download GTA 6’s 212GB preload, with some households still averaging download speeds of just 2.8Mbps.
articles.body:
It’s hard to believe it, but we’re currently living in a pre-GTA 6 world for just a few more days. The most anticipated game of all time, and Rockstar’s first since 2018’s Red Dead Redemption 2, is expected to push the technical, immersion, and storytelling boundaries of gaming in ways that felt inconceivable while we played 2013’s Grand Theft Auto 5.

One of the biggest changes since then has been the rise of digital gaming, and with Grand Theft Auto 6 coming in at up to 212GB, players have already been making liberal use of the pre-load functionality on PlayStation 5 and Xbox up to a week ahead of release.

Now, though, a study by Broadband Genie has suggested that that might not be enough.

UK Gamers Might Not Be Able to Pre-load GTA 6 in Time

Broadband Genie assessed data from over 17,000 recent speed tests undertaken through its own comparison tool, and found that 870,000 UK gamers could be waiting the full week for the game to download.

According to Broadband Genie’s calculations, a speed of 2.8Mbps or under will require a week of downloading, while a home reaching a download speed of 9.8Mbps will still take two days.

The report ranks Newport as the worst-hit city for downloading Grand Theft Auto 6. Over a third of speed tests in the city (35%) dropped below 2.8Mbps, meaning a wait of more than a week, while 41% of Newport tests remained below the 9.8Mbps threshold.

Given the bandwidth required, there’s a chance this would have a knock-on effect on internet usage beyond just the console, too, meaning working from home or streaming video would be hampered by the hefty download.

Gamers in Ely (24%), Hereford (17%), and Bath (16%) also face two days of downloading, while 9% of gamers in Torquay and Bangor are expected to be waiting for a week or more.

Alex Tofts, strategist at Broadband Genie, said ”the pre-load window is meant to guarantee day-one access, but it simply won’t save everyone.

“Nobody should have to put up with sluggish broadband, and this bottleneck couldn’t come at a worse time. After years of anticipation following the first GTA VI reveal, no one wants to find themselves stranded a full week behind other players.

“Slow download speeds can come from various factors, many outside your provider's control. There are practical steps players can take right now to avoid being locked out on launch day.”

Five Ways to Speed Up Your GTA VI Download

Tofts has also shared a few practical ways to supercharge (or at least speed up) your download so you can be exploring Vice City with the rest of the world come launch day.

“There are plenty of easy ways to get the most out of your internet connection. One way is to log into your router; the details are usually printed on the side. From here, you can enable the faster 5 GHz frequency.”

Toft also suggests removing devices you don’t recognise from your router’s list of connections to free up bandwidth, and turn off non-essentials.

“Before or during the download, switch off or disconnect any idle devices such as phones, smart TVs, laptops and tablets around your home. This will ensure all available bandwidth routes to your console.”

On your console of choice, you can also swap out your broadband provider’s default DNS server for a fast, public option.

“If your download is slow, your broadband provider’s default DNS server may be congested,” Toft explains.

“You can change your console’s network Domain Name System (DNS) settings to a fast public server such as Google Public DNS.”

Both Xbox and PS5 consoles have a sleep or rest mode that lets you continue downloading, and Toft recommends enabling that, too, while also hooking your console up via an Ethernet cable for a more consistent download speed.

articles.title: From a Land Far, Far Away - The Witcher 3 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: From a Land Far, Far Away is a somewhat lengthy Side Quest in The Witcher 3, where Geralt will need to track down and save a child that’s seemingly been
articles.body:
From a Land Far, Far Away is a somewhat lengthy Side Quest in The Witcher 3, where Geralt will need to track down and save a child that’s seemingly been kidnapped by a woman in the region.

To help you complete this Side Quest and contend with the different options on offer, here’s IGN’s guide to From a Land Far, Far Away.

To start this Side Quest, you’ll need to go to Hemdall’s Finger, off the coast of the island of Redgill. Here, you’ll need to track down a corpse slumped against a tree, along with a journal.

Have a look at the journal, then investigate the body and the crest of a nearby shipwreck. Geralt will come to the conclusion that whoever was on the shipwreck is clearly not from the region.

Get ready to go swimming! Dive down to check out the shipwreck and look for a chest with a special letter that’s been wax-sealed shut. There’s also a captain’s log here. Read both – the letter will be indecipherable, but the log will point you towards the village of Ursten to the south of Novigrad.

Make your way to the village. You’ll need to decide whether to speak to the warrior in town, or head straight to the coast to the south east of Widow’s Grotto. The best choice in From a Land Far, Far Away is to skip the warrior.

There’ll be a second shipwreck in the area, which you can investigate, finding footsteps and eventually leading you to a watch tower. A woman will run towards the watch tower and away from Geralt.

Keep following the woman, as she’ll lead you to a cave.

At the cave, try speaking to the woman. She’ll be clearly upset and scared, but you can hand her the captain’s log first, then the letter.

The warrior will arrive, upsetting the woman further. He’ll share that she’s an alleged kidnapper, and you’ll need to choose who to believe.

If you side with the woman, you’ll need to kill the warrior, but it’s a simple melee encounter. Focus on heavy attacks and staying to his side to avoid getting struck too heavily.

If you side with the warrior, he’ll kill the woman and the Side Quest will end.

If you kill the warrior, the woman will want to give you a reward, which you can accept or refuse. The Side Quest will end here.

When you finish the Side Quest, you’ll get 50 x experience. If you sided with the woman, you’ll get a stone medallion, too.

articles.title: 'He Needs a Second Chance' – Some Nvidia Employees Really Want Former CEO Jensen Huang Back
articles.summary: Shortly after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal involving multiple affairs and international espionage allegations, some employees of the company rallied to demand his reinstatement.
articles.body:
Shortly after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal involving multiple affairs and international espionage allegations, some employees of the company rallied to demand his reinstatement.

Nvidia's Board of Directors and the FBI launched an investigation into the 63 year old after he admitting having an affair with a woman alleged to have been a Chinese spy. The New York Times then reported that Huang had a second affair with an executive at his own company. It has since been reported that Huang had an affair with yet another Nvidia employee .

Nvidia provides advanced computer chips for everything from video games to cloud servers, but in recent years it has focused on the AI industry. Off the back of the enormous demand for memory to power data centers, Nvidia has become the world’s second-most valuable company, worth more than $4 trillion. However, stocks in the company fell on the news. Meanwhile, U.S. lawmakers on Capitol Hill have said Huang has indicated he is willing to appear before Congress for questioning.

In the hours after Huang's dramatic exit, a 'suggestion box' post on Nvidia's internal message board urging the company's Board of Directors to retain the CEO took off, getting around 1,600 comments, according to Wired. A majority of those comments were in support of reinstating Huang, and largely expressed sentiments that the Nvidia co-founder was instrumental to Nvidia's success over the last 33 years.

The comments themselves ranged from one employee saying, "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss," to, "We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance."

Nvidia employees have also taken to social media to voice support for Huang. Gavan Woolery, a senior research scientist at Nvidia, posted on X / Twitter: "Jensen Huang rescued me from probably living in debt the rest of my life. I was told I was one of just three hires that he approved during the pandemic, during a hiring freeze." Woolery added: "His personal life is frankly none of my business. But as a leader, I have yet to meet a better one. Ousting him is financial suicide, and I can only assume there is a hidden ulterior motive because I can't fathom any other reason for destroying the company's value."

Bryan Cantanzaro, VP of Applied Deep Learning Research and one of the people who helped invent DLSS, took to social media to say: "I'm terribly sad @JensenHuang is no longer leading @nvidia. Thank you Jensen. For the tireless work, for the focus, for the wisdom, for the support, for the vision, for the chance you gave me to do my life's work @nvidia."

Nvidia's employees are clearly fiercely loyal to the exiting CEO. According to a Blind survey of Nvidia employees conducted by Investing.com , 88% of workers thought Huang should have stayed on. That's contrasted with a seperate poll among a wider base of professionals outside of Nvidia, where support for Huang sat at just 60%.

It's not just employees that support Huang, though. Elon Musk has spoken out in support of him, as has Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, who tweeted yesterday: "A sad day for Nvidia, developers, America, and all humanity. Jensen founded and ran one of the few companies to reach a massive scale while driving massive continued innovation and ubiquity, while others fell into the trap of ever-increasing extraction."

However, due to the amount of heat that Jensen Huang's various affairs have brought down on Nvidia, it's unlikely that he will be reinstated. Instead, Nvidia's board has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO until a permanent successor has been found. Regardless, none of this bodes well for the gaming hardware that Nvidia's current AI empire was built on top of .

articles.title: My favorite recipe app just got a big upgrade — and a subscription fee
articles.summary: We spent hours with the beta and final release of Paprika 4 to determine whether the new subscription fee is worth the price.
articles.body: Nearly 10 years after the launch of Paprika 3, the recipe-managing, pantry-organizing, grocery list-making app has gotten a big upgrade that adds more functionality to nearly every corner of the experience. I tested Paprika 4 for several weeks while it was in open beta, and the update recently launched across Android (the version I’ve been using), iOS, Windows, and macOS. Where Paprika 3 was a one-time purchase per platform, accessing most of the new features in Paprika 4 requires an annual subscription fee of $14.99 (it can also be gifted). With the subscription, you can access the app on any supported platform. New users, as well as those who bought Paprika 3 (or previous versions) but don’t want to pay for the subscription, will be moved to a free version of Paprika 4, which comes with a smaller selection of features that were available to test in beta, plus the ability to save up to 50 recipes. Together, the new features locked behind the paywall make it possible to import recipes from social media and from physical cookbooks, scan product barcodes to organize your pantry or shopping list, and connect with other cooks via the app to share notes and recipes. They’re good, for the most part, and makes the subscription feel worth it. But the free version is upgraded in ways that make it worth trying if you’re hearing about Paprika for the first time. [Image: Every recipe maker lays out their recipes differently, but Paprika 4 lays them out neatly, assuming there’s enough info to parse (this is a good example of one that does have enough info). My favorite of the new subscription-exclusive features solves a conundrum I often find myself in: My wife sends me a lot of recipe videos on Instagram. I often take screenshots of the text to piece the recipe together. Paprika 4 can pull the pertinent info from those screenshots and build a recipe — that is, if there’s a complete enough recipe in the text to autofill in Paprika’s recipe fields. As an alternative to feeding the app a screenshot, you can send a social media post from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or Facebook to Paprika 4 straight from the share sheet, and it’ll scrape the caption and convert it in a few seconds. It won’t pull info from a video (which would be convenient — and controversial), and it’ll only work if there’s caption text in the photo or video post available to scrape. It sounds limited, but it’s a nice improvement, and it keeps the link to the social media post in the recipe so I can easily go back and view it as needed. A lot of social media accounts hide their recipes from people scrolling by, requiring an extra step like “comment with TASTYYUMYUM to get my free recipe.” I respect the hustle, even if I hate seeing this as I’m searching for recipes. Paprika unsurprisingly stumbles when recipe posts are too thin on parseable info. But for ones that have enough, it’s really easy to get them into the app. Paprika 4 also lets you import recipes with your phone camera. I’ve used it to take pictures from cookbooks that we own, and the app converts them accurately. On the free version, you’re limited to copy-pasting website URLs into the app’s browser and having it convert them into recipes that way. It works really well, but feels rudimentary by comparison. The updated app is stuffed with other new features, several of which are a tad superfluous (and less useful to me) but still seem good to offer when you’re hoping to attract subscribers. For instance, you can compile your recipes into your own digital cookbook to share with other users (this feature is in the free version, too) and set up family sharing — even DMing links within the app to other Paprika users. Family sub-accounts can be added to your account for no extra cost beyond the subscription, so long as they haven’t made a Paprika account with the same email address. [Image: The app can estimate the recipe’s nutritional value based on the ingredients and quantities. Paprika 4 can guess the nutrition facts of your recipes, which is nice if you have fitness goals or just generally like to know what kind of heat your food is packing, so to speak. I wouldn’t take the results to be totally accurate, but it seems capable enough. This feature is locked behind the subscription paywall. Another feature I could see myself using more of is the expanded pantry tool. Paprika 3 had a single “pantry,” but the paid and free versions of Paprika 4 let you specify where items are stored, such as in a cupboard, fridge, freezer, and anywhere else. I was also excited about the new barcode scanning feature, a premium feature that can quickly and easily add items to your pantry. While it didn’t work for me in beta, the scanning function works well in the current version. It recognized items that I frequently purchase at Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods, and a bodega. It adds what they are in simple terms (i.e., olive oil spray instead of “Trader Joe’s Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil Spray”). [Image: The barcode scanning tool that requires a subscription works really well, making it a breeze to add items to your pantry or grocery list. The Cook Mode is neat, and is available on both the free and paid versions of Paprika 4. When activated through a drop-down menu, the app reads the first step of the recipe out loud, waiting for you to chime in before continuing. You can ask it to repeat a step, go to the next one, double or halve the recipe, set timers, and strike steps or ingredients as you complete them, among other preset commands and questions. In this mode, the mic stays on by default, though the app won’t respond to unrelated chatter. If asking a prompt doesn’t get it to do anything, you can use the wake word “paprika” to reengage it. This feature has obvious accessibility benefits. There’s extensive Alexa integration, too, if you pay the subscription fee. It gives Alexa access to your recipes, grocery list, pantry, and meal plan. You can manage grocery lists and pantries by voice with Echo speakers, and screen-equipped Echo devices like the Echo Show can display recipes and support hands-free cooking. The iOS version of Paprika 4 also adds widgets and an array of shortcuts for iOS and macOS, like adding items to a grocery list or pantry, showing scheduled meals in your meal plan, and more. These don’t require a subscription. [Image: The premium (paid) version includes all of the features listed in the right and left phone screenshots. For people who are serious about staying organized in the kitchen — both in terms of their pantries and catalog of recipes — these paywalled features will likely get enough use each week to be worth paying for. Though, if you haven’t used Paprika before, the free version is a great place to start. Even as someone who was content with the features in Paprika 3, I can see the value in paying for the subscription-exclusive features. During the beta, I landed on $2 being a figure I’d be comfortable paying each month for them, and Hindsight Labs settled on just $1.25 per month. It’s going to be getting a lot more money per user than it ever has, but like most Paprika users, I would have purchased the app multiple times over due to how useful it is for me. I guess I get to do that now.

articles.title: Yaga Episode 5 Review: Hudson Williams Is Chilling in His Seduction While Carrie Anne-Moss Bewitches Anyone in Her Orbit
articles.summary: Yaga's latest episode brings intense seduction and intriguing reveals to the mystery-thriller series, drawing you in deeper to the world of Baba Yaga.
articles.body:
Warning: This review contains full spoilers for Yaga Season 1, Episode 5. Episodes 1-5 are now streaming on AMC+ in the US and Crave in Canada, with new episodes releasing on Fridays at midnight PT.

Following up on Episode 4’s chaotic and eventful ending, Episode 5 gives us the most reveals we’ve seen yet in Yaga. Picking up right where we left, we find out Laney is not in fact dead, but instead went into cardiac arrest – with a pissed off Eckert yelling at both Carson and Rapp for being the cause of it.

Rapp explains his theory as to what is happening in this town, which includes Laney thinking she is Baba Yaga and luring people such as Henry, Logan, Angel, and others into her chicken hut in the woods for manifestation rituals and sacrifices.

As they go their separate ways, we find out more unhinged details involving this mystery. Rapp ends up seeing a little girl (who very well may be a vision) who echoes what Laney said in the hospital – that Henry is a “bad dog” and is in Baba Yaga’s chicken house. Immediately after, Rapp finds a mysterious package in his rental car, and upon opening it, he finds a carved box with chicken feathers and what looks to be Henry’s phone. The sinister mask is set as the phone’s background and there’s a raw audio recording for him to play of the podcast episode Henry did with Katherine, which unfolds into fascinating revelations.

On the other side of things, Carson and Eckert are trying to track down who uploaded the video of Logan’s body by speaking to various people around town. One of the familiar faces is Katherine, who throughout the episode (and the show overall) seems to constantly drop suspicious clues, almost too casually, for it to not be intentional.

From mentioning the diner owner, Geena, cooking the chickens who stop laying eggs, to telling Carson she and Rapp “look good together” while giving her a sly look, to bumping into Eckert and seeing images of the mask, telling him she loves the artist’s work, Katherine seems to be dropping information right into their laps. And in this episode, it’s more apparent than it’s ever been.

As Rapp continues on his search in the woods, we see Katherine in her office with Henry recording the podcast, and surprisingly, Logan is there to manage the tech of it all. This is the first time we get to really see Hudson Williams at length as Henry, and his portrayal of the billionaire playboy is chilling while he tries to charm Katherine with his outright crude methods.

It’s pretty apparent that Henry is trying to get information on Baba Yaga for some reason, as he inquires about witches eating bones and casually mentions the retreat he attends – all with an obvious underlying sexual interest in Katherine.

Carrie-Anne Moss as Katherine absolutely owns this episode with her incredible storytelling and her ability to bewitch anyone in her orbit. By the end of the podcast (and the episode as a whole) you’re left wondering who actually seduced who into their bed? Who holds the power of the seduction?

The theme of men being inappropriate and downright sexually assaulting women in this show rears its ugly head yet again, with Henry having deliberately brushed his hand against Katherine’s breast without consent, and Eckert kissing Carson while they were at his house working on the case. In the latter scene, she shoves him off of her and he comments, “it’s not like I was trying to fuck you.” It’s a disturbing but accurate reality for many people and the show bringing this theme to light is as important as it is difficult to watch.

As night comes – and right when we think Rapp is actually focusing on being responsible – he makes his way over to Katherine’s house, surprising her. Yet she invites him in for dinner. While they discuss the podcast and details from it that Rapp is trying to get answers on, Katherine continues her casual attitude and shares how she relates to Baba Yaga. “She resonates with me, with women. She’s a figure of great power, wisdom, rage.” Rapp asks her if she’s angry about something, to which Katherine responds, “Women? We’re angry about everything.” Any woman watching this scene will likely relate to the safe door Moss just opened with the perfection that is that line.

Towards the end of the episode, we can sense how intoxicating the sexual tension is that has built up between Katherine and Rapp as, filled with passion and lust, they grab each other to have sex on her living room floor. On the opposite side of things, we get confirmation of Carson’s feelings for Rapp as she’s at her place, rightfully upset over her assault and that Rapp wouldn’t respond to her texts, as we see her sniff his tank top in her hands while pleasuring herself in the same moments Rapp and Katherine are having sex.

After they finish, we see Rapp looking at his reflection in the bathroom mirror – taking in the nail and bite marks and other bruises – when a vision seems to flicker through. Henry’s standing next to him, puts his hand around his throat and pulls him in for a brutal kiss. All of a sudden, Henry looks into the mirror, opens his mouth, and screams as blood pours out of it.

In that moment, the scene stops and jumps to Rapp jolting and standing in the hallway as he hears someone scream and pound on Katherine’s front door. He looks toward the clock on the wall, seeing the time flip to 3:33, and then sees Geena’s daughter, Lily, at the door. She starts throwing up blood as Katherine runs to grab her, while Rapp finds a tooth on the ground and holds it up in curiosity.

We’re now left with more questions than we started in this episode, including finding out Henry bought three of the creepy witch masks from the artist, while Rapp discovered a large triskele symbol made out of moss in the middle of the woods – which seems to be the circle Laney uses for her retreats. We also find out Katherine gifted Henry the Aztec knife that was allegedly the murder weapon for Logan, while lying smoothly to Rapp about it. Who do we think is behind all of this? Is there one true Baba Yaga or is it a cult of culprits?

articles.title: How to Get Village of Lu Cellar Key - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: There's a locked cellar door just north of the Smuggler’s Treasure Cellar Bell in the Village of Lu. You'll come across this door in Phantom
articles.body:
There's a locked cellar door just north of the Smuggler’s Treasure Cellar Bell in the Village of Lu. You'll come across this door in Phantom Blade Zero 's fourth chapter, Heartless Remnants . This short walkthrough will show you where to find the Village of Lu Cellar Key to unlock the cellar door leading to Uncle Lu’s treasure.

Jump to a specific section of the page using the header links below:

You won’t be able to obtain the Village of Lu Cellar Key until the very end of the Heartless Remnants story quest, before entering Pangzhen.

Open the puppet-face door in front of the Puppet Testing Grounds Crane Bell after defeating Mu Xiaokui. The path ahead splits in two. Go to the right to find a swordshield puppet guarding x2 Polished Twinned Metal, a Blackstone Shard, x2 Polished Broadplate Metal, x2,048 Remnant Dust, the Tunnel Cage Key , and a Refined Indigo Crystal.

The main item you need here is the Tunnel Cage Key, but there are also several collectibles in the room at the end of this path, including the following:

Backtrack and take the path to the left this time. Defeat a few puppets, then look to your right when the path splits again to see a locked door. Open the cell door with the Tunnel Cage Key, and the thief will reward you with the Village of Lu Cellar Key .

You can also open the cell door at the back of this room to find a puppet guarding x2 Camphor Timber and a chest containing x12 Solvent and x2 Polished Twinned Metal.

Return to the Smuggler’s Treasure Cellar Bell at the north end of the map, then jump down into the cellar and use the Village of Lu Cellar Key.

Inside, a swordshield puppet guards a golden chest containing the Remnant Spark Cage accessory, which gives a 33% chance to restore one Remnant Spark when you use a Phantom Edge follow-up attack.

You can also pick up a Traversal Talisman, a Phantom Reforge Talisman, x12 Solvent, x2,107 Remnant Dust, and x9 Incense Ash.

articles.title: WoW Forever Has a Weekly Quest That Can Reward Up to 100 Gold, and Players Don't Love It
articles.summary: Just a couple days after Blizzard changed the way gold was earned in max-level quests WoW Forever, the company has implemented a weekly quest with loot-box-style gold reward. And players don't love it.
articles.body:
Just a couple days after Blizzard changed the way gold was earned in max-level quests WoW Forever, the company has implemented a weekly quest with loot-box-style gold reward. And players don't love it .

Max level players have found a quest in Booty Bay called 'In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities,' which is offered each week, according to Wowhead . There is potential that the quest will rotate to different high level dungeons, but so far, for the two weeks Forever has been out, it's pointed players at Dire Maul, where they have to collect three items. The quest rewards a little bag that can drop one of four items at random that are worth either 10g, 20g, 40g, or 100g.

But while this is a way to get gold in a game where money is scarce, it is rubbing a lot of players in the community the wrong way. For a lot of people, it reminds them of retail WoW, which is built on top of piles and piles of weekly quests to pump additional gold into the economy.

WoW YouTuber Bellular posted the Wowhead link on X / Twitter, captioned simply by "uh what," and followed that up with some criticisms of the new weekly quest. He said: "Retail slop, kill! The way to generate gold is crafting, gathering, selling items. Want to do UBI? Make it sneaky via those means. Don’t show the hand of the designer so clearly." Bellular then tagged Blizzard associate production director Clayton Stone and added: "(pardon the spicy language - some genuine feedback) Let the player earn organically through game systems, not by making content a hoop to jump through."

But it's not just Bellular who's upset at the weekly quest. It's a similar sentiment over on Reddit, where ThatOldGuy7863 simply said : "dear god not weeklys." Meanwhile, drtakhs added: "F**k weeklies and dailies. I’ve been pretty happy with all the decision so far and the thought process behind them was reasonable. Now, what is this? Who wants this? No dailies, no weeklies and no FOMO bulls**t are among the most important things that make classic feel… well like classic…"

However, there may be an explanation for Blizzard's move here. EvadableMoxie suggested a repeatable quest for 100 gold "is aggressively anti-bot."

"It reduces the biggest benefit that bots have, the ability to run 24/7 by frontloading gold rewards," the continued. "This of course does not make bots useless but it reduces their advantage while letting players focus on other things than grinding out gold."

Blizzard has long struggled with bots messing with the economy in every version of World of Warcraft. In the beta, the company had to come down hard on people who were buying and selling gold, which is a direct consequence of botting. Simply put, it's not hard to program a bot to crawl zones for you and gather mining, herbalism or other materials to sell en masse on the auction house. A weekly quest that rewards gold could help players that don't have the time to compete with bots dumping industrial amounts of crafting materials keep up.

But players aren't mad that Blizzard is adding a way to earn gold. Rather, it's the addition of a weekly quest, that encourages players to log on every single week for fear of missing out on an injection of gold. This sort of repeatable quest also wasn't in the original game, with most types of daily and weekly quests not being added until The Burning Crusade.

This is just the latest change as Blizzard tries to nail down the identity of WoW Forever. While there are some parts of the original game that the company has stood firm on, like group tagging , there is an ever growing list of gameplay systems that Blizzard is actively tweaking in Forever, like Dungeon Experience and now, gold rewards.
